run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time gtn.compose and gtn.backward on batches of linear graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward score benchmark to time gtn.forward_score and gtn.backward on batches of graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for with a custom Python processing function
run_parallel_benchmarks_with_batch_size: run all parallel benchmarks by passing a batch size B as a command line argument
review_time_compose_function: review the time_compose function which creates linear graphs, adds arcs, and benchmarks parallel composition
